root.text: Stand, traveler! The Borderlands are under martial watch. Between the cultist incursions and the trance affliction, I cannot allow careless wanderers through.

options.text: [Diplomacy DC 14] I am an able adventurer here to aid Shroudgarde in securing the frontier.
[Intimidate DC 16] Out of my way, Constable. I have slain deadlier threats than you.
Forgive me, Constable. I will take my leave.

node_diplo_pass.text: Well spoken. We need all the steel we can muster. Take this Guard Signet — it proves your authority to explore the ruins and report back.

options.text: Thank you, Constable. I will not fail.

node_diplo_fail.text: Pretty words do not swing a blade against an orc warband. Come back when you have proven your mettle.

options.text: Understood.

node_intim_pass.text: T-there is no need for hostility! Pass through if you must, but whatever happens out there is on your own head!

options.text: Hmph. Wise choice.

node_intim_fail.text: You threaten a sworn officer of the realm? Watch your tongue before I have you clapped in irons!

options.text: Step back.

root.text: Welcome to the Golden Grain, stranger! Finest ale and warmest hearth in the Borderlands. What can I fetch you?

options.text: Show me your rations and provisions.
[Appraise DC 12] Your supplier from Orlane overcharged you on that batch of wheat.
[Bluff DC 14] Constable Derek sent me for complimentary provisions for our patrol.
Any rumors of the surrounding ruins?

node_appraise_win.text: By the gods, you are right! The grain sacks are cut with chaff. You have sharp eyes! Here, take a 15% discount on anything in my tavern.

options.text: Much appreciated, Bertram. Let me see your wares.

node_appraise_loss.text: Nonsense! Bertram knows good barley when he sees it. No discounts for amateur critics!

options.text: Fair enough. Show me what you have.

node_bluff_win.text: Ah, Derek`s boys! Never let it be said Bertram neglected the town guard. Here is a fresh loaf of crusty bread on the house!

options.text: Much obliged.

node_bluff_loss.text: Derek pays in coin like everyone else! Do you take me for a fool?

options.text: Never mind.

node_rumors.text: They say dark chanting echoes from the old Moathouse at midnight. And deeper still, past the Sunless Crypts, lies an endless subterranean abyss...

options.text: Thank you for the warning.

root.text: Clang and sparks! Keep back from the forge coals, surface-dweller. Looking for dwarf-forged iron that will not shatter against goblin bone?

options.text: Let me see your weapons and armor.
[Appraise DC 15] This breastplate has exceptional fold-welding. You take immense pride in your craft.
Can you forge adamantine gear?

node_smith_praise_pass.text: Ha! A surface-dweller with genuine appreciation for proper metallurgy! It is rare to meet someone who understands temper and quench. For you, artisan discount!

options.text: Show me your armory, Master Laurent.

node_smith_praise_fail.text: Do not flatter me to get a coin shaved off! Good steel costs what it costs.

options.text: Fair enough. Let me browse.

node_ore.text: If you bring me pure adamantine ore from the deepest vaults beneath the Dungeons of Doom, I will forge weapons worthy of kings!

options.text: I will remember that.

root.text: May the light guide your steps, traveler. The wounded from the borders arrive daily. How may the sanctuary aid you?

options.text: I need restorative potions and divine blessings.
[Diplomacy DC 13] The road is perilous, sister. A blessing for our quest would save many lives.

node_heal_pass.text: Your heart is pure. Go with the Dawnfather`s blessing, and take these consecrated elixirs at sanctuary cost.

options.text: Thank you, Sister Isabelle.

node_heal_fail.text: Our supplies are stretched thin caring for refugees. I can only offer what is listed in our apothecary.

options.text: I understand.

root.text: Step lightly. The woods have eyes, and not all of them belong to birds. Need bows, quivers, or scouts` gear?

options.text: Show me your archery equipment.
What trails lead towards the Ravine of Chaos?

node_tracks.text: Follow the northern deer paths through La Forêt Hantée. Watch the canopy — giant spiders nest above the moss line.

options.text: I will watch my head.

root.text: Rubies, sapphires, uncut chalcedony! Currency of empires and wizards alike. Are you buying or selling precious stones today?

options.text: Let me trade in gems and coin pouches.
[Appraise DC 16] Your rubies from the south carry high refraction. Let us make an equitable deal.

node_gem_pass.text: Splendid! A true connoisseur of gemstones! I will pay top coin for any jewels you unearth in the tombs.

options.text: Let us negotiate.

node_gem_fail.text: My prices reflect the standard guild tariff. Not a copper less!

options.text: Understood. Open the wares.

root.text: Ah, a wanderer entering my tower without triggering the warding runes. Impressive. Do you seek arcane knowledge, scrolls, or wands?

options.text: I seek magical scrolls and wands.
[Bluff DC 15] I am an emissary from the High Arcane Synod evaluating frontier towers.

node_mage_pass.text: The Synod? I was not notified! Of course, my facilities are at the disposal of esteemed colleagues.

options.text: Show me your grimoires.

node_mage_fail.text: The Synod uses celestial seals, charlatan. Do not insult my centuries of study with crude deception!

options.text: My apologies. Let me view your inventory.

root.text: I transcribe the histories of Shroudgarde and the fallen temples. What lore do you seek?

options.text: Tell me of the Temple of Elemental Evil.
What is the trance affliction gripping the peasants?

node_toee.text: Built atop a subterranean tear into the Lower Planes, the Temple was sealed decades ago. Yet rumors say cultists reassemble in the ruins of the Moathouse to breach the seals...

options.text: Thank you, Elena.

node_trance.text: The afflicted wander as if dreaming, muttering of a fungal goddess in the deep fane. It is no natural disease; it is the spores of Zuggtmoy.

options.text: Frightening. I must be careful.

root.text: Please, traveler... keep the monsters away from our thatched roofs. The night howls grow louder every moon.

options.text: Stay safe inside the walls. We will handle the menace.

root.text: Another mercenary sent by Constable Derek? How tragic that such vitality must end so brutally in the mud.

options.text: [Intimidate DC 17] Yield the Moathouse, Lareth, or Derek will display your head on the gate!
Draw your blade, cultist scum!

node_lareth_shake.text: You... you are stronger than the others. Perhaps we can reach an accommodation before steel is drawn...

options.text: No accommodations with the servants of evil!

node_lareth_laugh.text: Hahaha! Empty bravado! The Temple of Elemental Evil will swallow your pathetic bones!

options.text: Have at you!

root.text: A mortal worm dares trespass upon my golden hoard? Speak your final words before you are reduced to cinder and ash!

options.text: [Diplomacy DC 20] O Great Pyroclast, I bring offerings and tribute from the surface lords!
I come not to bow, but to claim your hoard and slay you!

node_dragon_pass.text: Hmm. You show proper reverence, tiny creature. Drop your tribute and crawl away, while my mercy endures.

options.text: Tread carefully backward.

node_dragon_fail.text: Fool! Your tribute is pitiful and your arrogance is fatal! BURN!

options.text: Brace for flame!
